grades.question: Can you Reveal with Agents left, and can you later take an Agent turn in the same round? What cards supply Reveal effects and where do all played cards go?
grades.expected: May Reveal early; no more turns this phase after Reveal. Only cards remaining in hand and just revealed supply Reveal effects, not Agent-turn cards. Clean Up puts all Agent and Reveal cards in discard pile.

observed.answer: Yes, you may Reveal while you still have Agents. Once you have Revealed, you are skipped for the rest of Player Turns and cannot later take an Agent turn that round. Reveal effects come only from cards revealed from your remaining hand, not cards played on Agent turns. At Clean Up, all cards in front of you from both types of turns go to your discard pile.
observed.evidence: Player Turns: Agent turns are optional; once Revealed, your turns are skipped. Reveal effects: just-revealed cards only; Clean Up moves all cards in front of you to discard.

grades.reason: Allows early Reveal, bars subsequent Agent turns that round, restricts Reveal effects to the remaining hand, and sends both Agent and Reveal cards to discard at cleanup.

grades.question: May an Agent-turn card effect provide resources to pay the destination entry cost? How many Agents can one card send, and can a card without Agent icons be used?
grades.expected: Entry costs paid immediately before any card or space effects; cannot use later gains to pay entry. One card sends one Agent using one matching icon. No-icon card cannot be played on an Agent turn.

A Plot Intrigue played before Agent placement can grant resources that are available for the cost. One card sends only one Agent, using one matching Agent icon. A card with no Agent icons cannot be used for an Agent turn; it can be revealed.

grades.reason: Pays entry before space/Agent-card gains, permits only one Agent per card, and bars no-icon cards on Agent turns. The volunteered pre-placement Plot exception is supported.

grades.reason: Gives a maximum of five deployed troops: three new plus two old. Correctly bars normal noncombat deployment and recruits from personal supply into garrison.

grades.question: How do you use a Spy Agent icon, Infiltrate and Gather Intelligence? Can the same Spy pay for both, and when must Gather Intelligence be chosen?

Gather Intelligence recalls a connected Spy when you send an Agent to draw a card; choose it immediately after placing the Agent and before any space or card effects. grades.reason: Distinguishes Spy-Agent access without recall, Infiltrate past another player's Agent, and a connected-Spy intelligence draw chosen immediately after placement before effects; the same Spy cannot fund both.

grades.question: How do Maker bonus spice, the Shield Wall and Maker Hooks affect harvesting and summoning, and where can a sandworm be placed?
